verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes an llms.txt at secureframe.com/llms.txt and markdown page variants such as pricing.md, which agents can ingest. Its MCP docs are written for connecting AI assistants, but the evidence only shows these files exist as sources, not what the llms.txt covers. missing for 10: documented llms.txt contents or structure, evidence that agent-oriented docs cover the API/developer reference (not just marketing pages), independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Connect an AI assistant to your Secureframe workspace and query or update your compliance data through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Any MCP-capable client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, and others) can connect
